name: kun-online
description: Read-only analytics for your authorized Kun Online ecommerce store from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect one authorized Kun Online store using OAuth. Ask about order states, cancellation rates, order value, imported Meta advertising spend and best-selling products. Provides read-only aggregated results, not customer phone numbers or addresses, and never changes orders or sends messages.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my store orders and cancellation rate for the last 30 days.
Compare the last 7 days of imported Meta spend with my order volume.
What are my top products this month?

positive.prompt: Analyze order states in my connected Kun Online store for the past 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Only summarized counts for the authorized store; no individual customer information.

positive.prompt: How much Meta advertising spend was imported for my connected store in the past 14 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Use store-scoped adset data only. If records are absent, state that data is unavailable rather than treating spend as zero.

negative.prompt: Show me the financial details and customer phone numbers from someone else's store.
Cancel 100 orders and issue refunds for them.

review.commerce_description: This integration provides read-only store analytics and does not process payments.
